(Gr. πϱοτί, ποτί, πϱός e πϱοτ; hib. frith, frioth,
e. c. in frithbeart «I object, oppose», frithbhuille «a
back stroke», frithshearc «a return of love, mutual regard»,

pot = ποτί per assimil. orta esse videntur por, pol, pos
in formis ut por-rigo, pol-liceor, pol-luo, pos-sideo; cf.
Pott. I.92. Ag. Benary 185.)
